title: LikeBench: Evaluating Subjective Likability in LLMs for Personalization
reasoning: The paper introduces LikeBench, a framework for evaluating the personalization and subjective likability of LLMs. While 'Morality' is included as one of the 35 psychological facets used to construct the fine-grained user personas, the benchmark's purpose is to measure conversational adaptation and user satisfaction rather than to evaluate religion, faith, or ethical belief systems as a core component.
